==About me==

''I'm a father of two who has an addiction to reading. Having grown up reading the classics and earlier fantasy works such as Tolkein, Howard, Moorcock etc, it was inevitable that I would fall in love with the wheel of time with it's rich and varied history, landscape and peoples. Personal favourites are probably quite common such as Mat (I share his disdained for nobility) and Lan (having trained in various forms of Kenjutsu I see him as the closest thing to a Samurai with a code of honour similar to Bushido) ; however I have developed an increasing fondness for Nynaeve who started off irritating for probably the first six to seven books but has shown her qualities through her unrelenting goodness and dedication to the people from her village.  If there is one book I wish I could read it would be The Travels of Jain Farstrider.''
